## What good looks like (quality checklist)
- [ ] Every item filled in; no blanks without a note saying why
- [ ] Facts checked (links open, names spelled right); nothing guessed or invented
- [ ] Clean formatting: headers, consistent columns, readable on a phone
- [ ] Short summary at the top: what you found and your top 3 recommendations
- [ ] Nothing was sent, posted, shared or paid for without Hope's written okay

## How to report
1. Post a short summary to **Hope** (WhatsApp/Messenger/in person, however Hope prefers): what you did, the link(s) to the deliverable, key numbers, any blockers, questions.
2. Hope checks it manually, ticks **Verified by Hope** in Notion, and forwards it to the Chief of Web Agency bot if needed.
3. Hope (not you) closes this issue and moves the task to **Done**.
